verdict.rationale: Hybrid cloud offload is a fair question for a local LLM runtime, so the axis applies. The evidence shows llamafile is local-only: it states "No cloud" and says the server cannot make outbound connections. Nothing documents a hosted tier or remote execution for large models.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can offload very large models to a hosted cloud tier without downloading them when my local hardware is insufficient
